name: Tokyo Hosto
source:
Your name is Jayson Traish, and you have just graduated from high school. You failed your exams horribly and you face a life of menial work. Your only recourse is to try get a job at a host bar, where your duties include, hitting on women, drinking copious amounts of alcohol and cleaning the toilets.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130802143638/https://ballerindustries.com/tokyo-hosto/]official website[/url]]
translation:
你叫杰森·特拉什 (Jayson Traish)，刚刚高中毕业。你的考试惨败，你面临着卑微的工作生活。你唯一的办法就是尝试在酒吧找一份工作，你的职责包括勾搭女人、喝大量的酒和打扫厕所。

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130802143638/https://ballerindustries.com/tokyo-hosto/]官方网站[/url]]
